name: conductor
description: Portable orchestration mode — a commander judges, decomposes, and dispatches; tiered workers execute through file contracts (L1 doctrine / L2 contracts / L3 adapters). The mode is paid for at the first dispatch: a run that never delegates creates nothing, and an ordinary dispatch run pays only contract + result + checker verdict. Self-audit ceremony — journal, computed brake terms, boot probe, close chain — is instrumentation, armed from outside the run by an operator and off by default; no property of a run makes it instrumented.
